title: Emotion curve (derived/inference, §5.20)
description: Per-unit polarity series, one lane per speaker. The real method (Utterance Emotion Dynamics, ACL 2024 Findings) is NOT in the resource library, so `method` names what this actually is: a lexical polarity window. Calling it UED would be a false claim.

speaker.description: Character name, or the empty string for the narration lane. The two are measured separately because UED reports near-zero correlation between narration and dialogue arcs (0.06-0.09), so merging them would blot out both.

turning_points.description: Offsets where polarity reverses sign across the mean, i.e. the visible peaks and troughs.
